title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Business Paper 1 (Short Answer and Data Response)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Business 0264 Paper 1: four compulsory 20-mark questions with stimulus material, 1 hour 30 minutes, 80 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** four questions. You have 1 hour 30 minutes.

- Each question is worth 20 marks; the last part of each asks you to justify a decision.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 1 of the 2027-2029 syllabus; the part marks are our convention. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Business Paper 2 (Case Study)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Business 0264 Paper 2: four compulsory 20-mark questions on one case study with appendices, 1 hour 30 minutes, 80 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Read the case study and its appendices, then answer **all** four questions. You have 1 hour 30 minutes.

- Apply every answer to the business in the case; part (b) of each question asks you to justify a decision.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 2 of the 2027-2029 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
